QF.id: SIA Logic Model for Social Programs_35

question.text: Per Ch 4.3.2, KPIs for social impact should address which three attributes of a social/environmental/cultural project?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 4.3.2, KPI design considers relevant social, environmental and cultural parameters specifically addressing Reach, Depth and Inclusion attributes of the project. Reach = number of beneficiaries; Depth = intensity/quality of change per beneficiary; Inclusion = coverage of marginalised / intended subgroups. The Trap: A is financial. C is capital-structure. D is temporal. None match the triad the chapter specifies for impact KPIs. Cross-Exam Context: Reach/Depth/Inclusion is tested in XXIII Ch 5 and SAS-400 gender assurance (XXIII Ch 7). Assessor's Pro-Tip: For every material outcome, demand all three: Reach (coverage numbers), Depth (how much change per person), Inclusion (marginalised sub-group breakdown). Reach-only indicators inflate apparent impact.
